description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister shares U.S. response to Sundar Pichai’s Visakhapatnam AI hub proposal
body_lead: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu reposted a reply by Jacob Helberg, U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Growth, Energy and Environment, to Google CEO Sundar Pichai’s message on X (formerly Twitter). Mr. Pichai had expressed happiness over his discussion with Prime Minister Narendra Modi about plans to establish Google’s first-ever AI hub in Visakhapatnam. Mr. Pichai said the proposed hub would integrate gigawatt-scale compute capacity, a new international subsea gateway, and large-scale energy infrastructure.
